IT Support Engineer

Professional Summary:
IT Support Engineer with over 2 years of experience providing technical support, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, maintaining computer systems, and assisting users in enterprise environments. Technical Skills:
Python (Basic), SQL (Basic), Windows Administration, Linux (Basic), Microsoft Office, Hardware Troubleshooting, Network Troubleshooting, Active Directory, Customer Support, Git (Basic).

- Resolved hardware and network connectivity issues.
- Managed user accounts using Active Directory.
- Created simple Python scripts to automate repetitive administrative tasks.

Technical Support Intern | NetServe Technologies | January 2022 - February 2023
- Assisted senior engineers in troubleshooting desktop and laptop issues.
- Installed software applications and configured office systems.
- Documented technical incidents and resolutions.

Projects:
1. Employee Help Desk Ticket Management System using Python.
2. Basic Inventory Management System using SQLite.

University of Central Punjab
